LTB4, a leukotriene, is also involved in increasing vascular permeability and is known for its role in inflammation and chemotaxis. IL-8 and Neutrophil chemotactic factor (NCF) primarily function in neutrophil recruitment and do not have a well-established role in directly increasing vascular permeability or synergizing with PGE2.
